notes.title: It’s Update Time Again!
notes.content:
[h1]🕷️ SpiderHeck Update Alert! 🕸️
[/h1]
[h3]Hey Everyone![/h3]

It’s update time! Our latest update, the [b]1.5.2 Quality Of Heck Update[/b] is out now! 

This update has focused on squashing some of the bugs we’ve found and had reported by you guys and gals in the community!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6z0zVWf.gif[/img]

[b]The update includes the following fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Players and Enemies occasionally spawning while invisible in Wave Mode.
[*] Stopped death cubes rotating slower on dedicated servers.
[*] Fixed Weapons turning invisible, swapping textures or  becoming intangible.
[*] Fixed Boomstick losing texture after it explodes the first time when the player has Efficiency.
[*] And more!
[/list]
If you find any bugs or issues please let us know on our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/KpzuAm6rVJ]here[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mDHqIfv.gif[/img]

Stay heckin' awesome, SpiderHeck community! 🕸️💥

notes.title: SpiderHeck 1.5 - New Year (New York) Update
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the SpiderHeck New Year's extravaganza! 
[/h2]

[previewyoutube=oU2uZgZyx5A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]As usual. we've got a bag full of goodies for you, so let's dive in:[/h3]

🏰 [b]NY Lobby[/b]
Feel the festive vibes with snowballs right in your lobby. Because, why not bring the winter wonderland inside? There’s also a Christmas Tree with the best decorations!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QLrA9X8.gif[/img]

🗺️ [b]4 New Community Maps[/b]
Explore fresh community-made maps and embrace the creativity of the SpiderHeck community. There's always something new to discover.
[list]
[*] Panopticon
[*] Reactor (versus and survival)
[*] Shackle
[*] Arme (versus and survival)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0ZGpsnS.gif[/img]

🗺️[b]8 Refreshed Maps[/b]
We’ve looked at some of the older maps and given them a bit of a touch up, making them better, faster, stronger and more deadly…
[list]
[*] Dead Weight
[*] Compactor
[*] Cargo
[*] Humdrum
[*] Ribs
[*] Skull
[*] Trash Barrage
[*] Cove
[/list]
🏆 [b]Bi-weekly Limited Tiers of Heck Challenges[/b]
Test your skills with challenges crafted by the community. Some are tricky, some are downright bizarre. How many can you conquer? Each has a unique hat to gain by beating it! 

🎭 [b]NY Cosmetics[/b]
And completing those limited tiers will let you ring in the New Year in style! Check out the latest hats in the Scroll of Heck. Fashion-forward spiders, this is for you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mDHqIfv.gif[/img]

🔐 [b]Invite Codes in Friends-only Game Mode[/b]
Enjoy exclusive sessions with friends. Invite codes bring a touch of exclusivity to your SpiderHeck experience.

🚫[b] Restriction on Custom Maps in Cross-Network[/b]
To maintain balance, custom maps are now restricted in cross-network game mode. Fair play for everyone!

🛠️[b] Issues Fixed[/b]
We've squashed pesky bugs, corrected localization issues, and improved gameplay mechanics. SpiderHeck is now smoother and more enjoyable. Some examples below!

[list]
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Light Steps modifier no longer allows moving objects with mines
[*] "There could be non-xbox network users in the game" pop-up doesn't display when connecting to cross-network lobby via find a match
[*] Player melee knockback fixed
[*] Fixed incorrect voting mechanics in wave survival mode
[*] Add shotgun sound on equip
[/list]
[h3]🕷️ SpiderHeck 1.5 is live! Dive into the New Year festivities. 🎮🎊[/h3]

notes.title: Update Time!
notes.content:
[h1]🕷️ SpiderHeck Version 1.4.1: QOL Patch 2 is Here! 🎉🕸️[/h1]

SpiderHeckers, get ready for our latest update! Here's what's new in Version 1.4.1: QOL Patch 2:

🌐Connectivity Evolution: Dedicated Server improvements!

🌐Connection Type Switcher: Choose between Peer-to-Peer (P2P) and Dedicated Server (DS) connections with a new switcher.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vfTmBgp.gif[/img]

🔧 Bug Fixes and Tweaks

We've squashed some spi…, er, bugs, and made improvements. Loads of em. Too many to list! But there are loads!

As an example: 

[list]
[*] Fixed wave mode enemies not spawning if you killed the last enemy in a wave while in ghost form when all your teammates are dead
[*] Fixed the Shaman enemy’s fireball not disappearing on death
[*] Fixed music stopping working when joining a lobby
[*] Fixed an exploit with dropping and picking up weapons - the spider will now teleport behind the weapon if you spam pick up in Versus Mode.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/t5Qvcsb.gif[/img]

The Update is available now! If you find any issues, or have any questions, thoughts or just generally want to talk about SpiderHeck then join our [url=https://discord.gg/KpzuAm6rVJ]Discord Server[/url] now! 

Follow us on X: https://twitter.com/SpiderHeck_Game
Join The Discord: https://discord.gg/KpzuAm6rVJ

notes.title: 1.3 Scroll Of Heck Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Gang![/h1]

[b]It’s Out. Now. Go Play.[/b]

What? You want details? Eugh. FIne. Here are the Patch Notes:

[previewyoutube=frk7yv3tw-o;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Versus presets - Preset configurations for versus mode. Become a "Blademaster" in Particle Blade only duels or practice your accuracy in "One Shot".

[*] New levels - Seven brand new versus levels are available! These levels include various new physics platforms and hazards. Swinging lasers, platforms suspended on breakable chains, hornets and more!

[*] Dedicated servers - Versus mode is now using a beta version of new dedicated servers!

[*] Scroll of Heck< - A list of the in-game cosmetic unlocks for you completionists. Complete the scroll and earn even more spider colors!

[*] Limited Tiers - Time limited Tiers of Heck challenges will periodically become available. Complete these to earn unique cosmetics!

[*] Achievements - New achievements have been added for beating pain levels and parkour.

[*] New map editor objects - New objects are available in the map editor.

[*] Modifier “One Shot” made available in versus settings

[*] Web now properly disconnects if the object spider is webbing to gets destroyed.

[*] Fixed: In versus map selection the “Custom maps” and “Default maps” buttons are not translated and are displayed in english.

[*] Fixed an issue where players could make  custom tier with no waves.

[*] Fixed - The 'Name the map' menu stays over the screen after pressing the 'ESC' key on the 'Name the map' menu.

[*] Fixed - The background of the new created map fails to display in the custom map after saving the new map using a dot '.' in the name of custom map New versus mode. 

[*] Fixed - Player1 able to customize and access player2 character in customize screen

[*] Fixed - “select none/all” option jumping around in versus map selection screen.

[*] Auto Shotgun - Each burst now counts as a separate shot. No more half bursts when modifiers are enabled.

[*] Auto Shotgun - Reworked recoil - less kick for aiming, more pushback on spider on each shot.

[*] Lobby reworked to make islands easier to find.

[*] Default Versus round count is now 7.
 
[*] Other minor changes and fixes that Neverjam forgot to list.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=De-W7maBzH0;full][img][/img][/previewyoutube]

If you find any bugs please head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/KpzuAm6rVJ]Discord[/url] and let us know!

See you in SpiderHeck!

notes.title: 1.25 Quality Of Heck Update - Introducing Versus Map Editor!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Gang![/h1]

We promised, now we deliver - today marks the release of the [b]1.25 Quality of Heck[/b] update!

This update introduces the new[b] Versus map editor[/b], as well as a plethora of quality of life fixes and improvements. You can find more details in the full patch notes below!

We’re also going to be announcing a new map maker competition in the next few days, so keep your eyes peeled on Discord and go join it if you haven’t so you can take part!

[b]Here’s the full patch notes: [/b]

[h1]SpiderHeck - 1.25 QUALITY OF HECK update notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Versus map maker is now available. 

[*] Options for different style of cursors were added for better visibility. 

[*] “Show player names” button is now rebindable. 

[*] Holding a mouse button now lets you spawn a spider.

[*] Fixed an issue with Tiers of Heck menu background on ultra widescreen devices.

[*] An option was added for changing how player names are displayed. You can now disable them or only show the “P1, P2, P3” markers.

[*] “Show player names” button is now a toggle instead of a hold. 

[*] An option was added for changing how player names are displayed. You can now disable them or only show the “P1, P2, P3” markers.

[*] “Show player names” button is now a toggle instead of a hold. 

[*] “Toggle all” option added to versus map screen.

[*] In case of lost saves, hats linked to achievements will now be regranted on launch.

[*] Survival mode respawns have been improved, the game will try and avoid spawning you on top of your allies.

[*] Parkour maps now have an indicator to show where your web will land.

[*] A new color reward “SYNTH” has been added for reaching wave 30 on pain level 7.

[*] Added some balls to the waiting room for entertainment.

[*] Tier of Heck names now shown in the loading screen.

[*] Bunch of minor bug fixes that Neverjam was too lazy to list.

[*] Some functions were added in the game's codebase to let modders make menus easier.
 
[/list]
Now, go kill spiders!

notes.title: OUR PARK Update is out now!
notes.content:
Heya!

The long-awaited [b]‘OUR PARK’ Update[/b] is finally here! 

[h2]Check out the new trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=di8-RLofXzM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Parkour Mode & Map Editor[/h2]
Welcome to a new game mode [strike]that will make you suffer[/strike] in which you will experience the full range of incredible emotions!

Master the parkour course by completing all 18 maps explicitly designed to make you feel pain and satisfaction simultaneously, with even more maps to be added in the future! Beat the creator's time and set records for your friends to take on! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/8c6cd5d617d5c63b07d1429c3b69328c0b306819.png[/img]

You can also create your own maps and share them with the community using [b]Steam Workshop[/b]. Experiment with different blocks, objects and even physics and gravitation to create your masterpiece maps. Or, if you are up for the challenge - check out the pool of community-created maps and try your luck! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P0Crr3a.gif[/img]

[h2]New weapons and customization options[/h2]
We've also added new weapons to the game that will allow you to annihilate your enemies even more effectively. Or fall victim to your own shots, lol.
[list]
[*] Auto Shotgun
[*] Gravity Saw
[*] Gravity Grenade
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/39k9FlN.gif[/img]

Don't forget to try on the new hats you get for completing the parkour maps. Just look at these high-fashion items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/75061bdd861822f05463a630c2ef930669fd2528.png[/img]

[h2]EULA Addition[/h2]
Our lawyers have urged us to add a EULA to the game (especially since players can now create their own content) and tell you about it in an upcoming post. So there you have it, we told you about it.

[h2]The complete list of changes[/h2]
We have, of course, made a few bug fixes and improvements to the game, so check out the complete list of changes below.
[list]
[*] [b]Added new Parkour island[/b] with solo parkour challenges!
[*] [b]Added three new customization items[/b] (Fox, Winner and Diamond) that can be unlocked by beating the parkour challenges.
[*] [b]Added the Parkour Map Editor with Steam Workshop integration[/b].
[*] [b]Added three new weapons:[/b] Auto Shotgun, Gravity Saw and Gravity Grenade.
[*] [b]Hecksaw has been modified![/b] Its effectiveness as a melee weapon has been reduced: in some circumstances, it will launch automatically if used in melee. To offset this, it has gained targeting lasers for easier use as a projectile weapon.
[*] [b]Death by disintegration[/b] has become [b]more instant[/b].
[*] [b]Reduced max cooldown[/b] on web usage.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some players to load randomly into the Tiers of Heck mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the camera to be more zoomed out in multiplayer matches.
[*] Lots more small polish all over the place.
[*] Added EULA to PC version of the game.
[/list]
Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/cjagRmW]Discord[/url] for more fun!

notes.title: [April Fool's Day] Introducing the Arachnophobia Mode
notes.content:
Hello friends!

If, for whatever reason, you still find time to pay attention to what your spider looks like in the heat of battle, then we have some great news!
Today we are bringing you a new way to play SpiderHeck - [b]Arachnophobia Mode![/b] 

[h2]What the heck[/h2]
Yes. You can choose from a few different options that suit you best. Fully transform your spider into something completely different, add your own face and more! Let us show you!

[h2]‘SpiderSnek’ or ‘the more you know’ paragraph[/h2]
Originally, we wanted to go with butterflies and all. Still, it turns out there’s a [b][i]Lepidopterophobia[/i][/b], so we would end up in a situation where we would have to develop another phobia mode, so we scraped this idea. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5eyxpM6.gif[/img]

[h2]Not quite a spider[/h2]
Alternatively, you can upload your own photo [i](Terms and Conditions apply. Read the 187-page end-user licence agreement)[/i] and literally be in the game! We know it's not exactly a full-fledged replacement for our cutest little spiders, but we do want to give you a choice!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/x6L08Ab.gif[/img]

[h2]IF NOTHING ELSE WORKS[/h2]
If you still can't play SpiderHeck with your eyes open, this option is definitely for you! Simply disable the legs display and turn your spider into a ping-pong ball.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dbrbdj9.gif[/img]

And if that is still not enough…
[b]FEAR NOT - NOW YOU WON'T SEE ANYTHING.[/b]

Completely turn off the spider models so nothing will distract you from the intense gameplay. Just remember to wear a hat so you'll at least have a rough idea of where the heck you are.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TTI2Rsg.gif[/img]

We hope this game mode will finally help you and your friends truly enjoy the crazy gameplay full of incredible parkour, powerful explosions, OMG moments and treacherous "completely accidental" friendly fire.

Let us know what you think in the comments below!

notes.title: Another Online Multiplayer Playtest! [COMPLETED]
notes.content:
[h1][COMPLETED][/h1]

[h2]We need [b]MORE[/b] playtesters![/h2]

Last time you managed to find some bugs and gave us a lot of helpful feedback. We seek your help again. Please, remember that the main goal of playtests is to detect issues with the game, analyze and fix them.

[i]This Online Multiplayer Playtest is available [b]until the 5th of August.[/b][/i]

[h2][b]Playtest Key Points:[/b][/h2]

— To engage you more, we reworked the weapon and map selection compared to the previous playtest;

— A dev console will be available to help us gather feedback. Just don’t be afraid of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/a389d3f0f01d5281196c5a6aecc357397d3e8b03.png[/img]

[h2][b]And the most important:[/b][/h2]

If you are facing an issue, please share the log files with us, as it will be easier for our team to analyze and fix a bug. [b]Here is a short instruction on how to report a bug:[/b]

[h3][b]Option 1:[/b][/h3]

1. Press "Win+R";
2. Paste it "AppData\LocalLow\Neverjam Studio\SpiderHeckApp" in the window that comes up. Press Enter;
3. Send us your Player file to the # bug-reports channel on [url=http://discord.gg/cjagRmW]our Discord server.[/url]

[h3][b]Option 2:[/b][/h3]

1. Please press the button "Open Log File" on the dev console;
2. Save the file as .txt or copy it and paste it into https://pastebin.com/;
3. Send the file to the # bug-reports channel on [url=http://discord.gg/cjagRmW]our Discord server.[/url]

[b]❗️ Warning:[/b]

If you are using the second method, you should get the file before restarting the game. If you restart the game, the log is rewritten and the key information is lost.

In case you stumbled upon a bug, forgot to save a log file and exited the game, please use the first method.

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Playtest update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, HeckStars![/h1]

The online multiplayer playtest has been going on for a week now, and we’ve received a lot of feedback, suggestions, and even some criticism [i](which is good)[/i]!

HOWEVER!
We need more feedback and more testers! 

We’re excited to announce that after the first round of feedback, [b]the online multiplayer playtest is now available to everyone![/b] We took a lot of comments we received into account, and we’re also updating the playtest with some new sweet features!

[h1]Customization system[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/777fb6ea645dc1b4afb8c2aed4b757e637b5b07e.jpg[/img]

Who (or what) do you want to be today – a samurai? How about fruit? Depending on your mood, choose different hats and colors for your spiders! 

Spiders colors are available by default, but hats are unlocked by getting achievements (to make it more interesting, we suggest you try to find them yourself 😉) 

To customize your spider, jump to the island on the left side of the main lobby.

[h1]New weapons[/h1]

[h3][b]Double Particle Blade[/b][/h3]
This weapon features two blades on each side. Throw, spin, deflect attacks and crush your friends (or foes) with twice the power! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/cf5c79924292a5968e6ba3518e95c750b9f39bae.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hecksaw[/b][/h3]
A weapon that shoots a disc that deals damage. The disc does not disappear immediately, it is active for a while and moves by bouncing off surfaces. Try it on the new Ant Domain map! 😉 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/0e3d3bb55497d1b0dd1bf573fd1e268f74bbdcfd.png[/img]

[h1]New maps[/h1]

[h3][b]Swings[/b][/h3]
You will have to fight on platforms that resemble swings on this map. Pushing your friends into lava is now easier than ever. 

[h3][b]Ant Domain[/b][/h3]
A closed map in the form of a labyrinth. With its many branching tunnels, there’s plenty of room for strategy, but limited space will make it harder for you to dodge your enemy’s attacks. Plan your battle accordingly!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/8d8a5b9e182ddfe0aefaf55496f230bc44ecd7cc.png[/img]

As a reminder, this online multiplayer playtest is available until [b]June 9th, 23:59 GMT[/b], so you still have plenty of time to share your feedback with us!

You can join the playtest by clicking ‘Request Access’ on the game’s Steam page

notes.title: “A New Heck” - SpiderHeck 0.76 update is out now
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

The holidays are approaching us and I thought it would be a great idea to release the new update for the SpiderHeck demo just in time for Christmas for you to enjoy throughout the holiday break!
 
This one is packed full of new and revamped features, so let’s dive straight into some of the most interesting things!

[h2]Map pool & weapon rotation[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/laehdoO.png[/img]

SpiderHeck features a great number of maps to play on as well as weapons to fight with! I’ve been busy working on a new weapon and maps lately, so in order to balance things a bit, the decision to rotate out nine out of ten old maps has been made.This way you get to experience new arenas more often. But not to worry! All of these will be back in the final version once the game is released.  

[h2]New enemies[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eRKPdIK.png[/img]

If you follow the official SpiderHeck Discord and the game’s page on Steam, you might have already seen these fellas before! If not (well, too bad) you can check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1329500/view/3128309602025365512]latest devlog[/url] where I introduced these new enemy types to the community. Forewarned, forearmed.

[h2]New perks & Game mode Improvements[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Mo3Jcmy.png[/img]

With new maps, weapons and enemies, comes new perks and game balance. You’ll be able to choose from the variety of new perks and boosters to survive longer and perform better.  How would you like to have a bigger explosion radius or get new weapons much faster to deal with those pesky Whisps? I’ve got you covered. Just know that the total number of perks has doubled now. Wow.

Some of these perks are too crazy now and are likely to backfire on you. So keep your many eyes out! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7ZH1kMB.png[/img]

I’m also playing around with some new game mechanics, like shields in the Versus mode. This modifier allows players to literally spawn with a shield around that protects them from one hit moves. The Survival mode has also been rebalanced a bit. For example, you’ll now notice how the game does enemy spawns to provide more of a challenge at later waves (as if things were easy before!).

[h2]Community Map Contest Creation Winner[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xLZMZjC.png[/img]

Earlier this month we held our very first community map creation contest and I’m pleased to say that the winner’s map is now available for everyone to play! Introducing the [b]“Ant Domain”[/b] by [b]The Taker.[/b]

This unique map features a system of winding tunnels and will definitely put your skills to the test! Try to beat your enemies in this closed environment or fail miserably, it’s up to you to decide your faith. 

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Just like everything else on this stage of development this map might be adjusted and rebalanced in future. Since this is the first map that’s been designed in a closed environment, I have no idea if the AI will like it or not and how it will adapt to it. You’ve been warned!

I also wanted to thank everyone who has submitted their ideas and map concepts to the competition! I’ve seen some really amazing stuff out there and I will probably utilize some of this as an inspiration for future maps. I will also recreate 4 additional maps that made it to the final community poll in the future updates, so keep your eye peeled. 

[h2]New music tracks[/h2]
The size of the demo soundtrack has doubled with the addition of these new funky tracks by [b]Professor Kliq[/b].
[previewyoutube=uzjv6m0UlSM;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=f_mLsLFy8as;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New weapon[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pxA0vfW.gif[/img]

Last but not least, I’m introducing a new weapon to your evergrowing arsenal! I don’t want to go into all the details on this one, so I’ll leave you with this to figure out all the nuances yourselves! 

Thank you so much to everyone who helped me with this project throughout the year! Your continuous support means the world to me and I can’t wait for you to see the final product.

I wish you all very Happy Holidays and I’ll see you next year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39305422/0a357e5278d127ac3cc57026eca4726d6c57dfa5.png[/img]

Thank you,
Neverjam

notes.title: Devlog: Introducing New Enemy Types!
notes.content:
Heya! Time for a non-regularly scheduled devlog.

It's been a couple of months since I released the [b]SpiderHeck[/b] demo on Steam and [b]BY THE WAY[/b], thank you all for playing it, we have been consistently hovering on 1st and 2nd page of most popular demos, and that to me is kind of mindblowing!

Based on your feedback, I am happy with how the game plays and looks, so I have been mostly focusing on polishing and adding more content. Today I’d like to show you something new. 

If you don’t want to read through this post, feel free to check out the video version of the devlog.

[h1]Watch the New Devlog [/h1]
[previewyoutube=5Rt_Lk09dFU;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Please note: this is still work in progress and not all of these enemies might end up being in the final version of the game.[/i]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you have played the demo, you are already familiar with the two existing enemies. These current enemies either try to stab you with their stingers or roll you over with their… rollers?
So with the new enemies, I wanted to change up the gameplay a little bit and the obvious way to do that when all your enemies are melee is by adding some ranged enemies! I know. Genius.

[h1]Introducing new enemies[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DR3shwa.png[/img]

First new enemy I worked on was this bug thing I am calling Khepri. For some reason my brain didn’t let me just make a wasp with a gun (even though it does sound kind of cool when I write this) because I needed to do something “interesting”, so I ended up with this beetle thing… that shoots energy spheres at you.

There are a couple of cool things about it. Initially, the projectiles it shoots were meant to be fast and very bouncy, kind of like the ones you may remember from the Half Life 2. But, I quickly realized that giving something like that to the enemies was going to get very frustrating for players. All the bounciness is going to lead to a lot of random deaths… which let’s be honest… the game already has plenty of.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/llJRtap.gif[/img]

So instead I slowed the projectiles down quite a bit, and to still keep them a threat, made the spheres bigger while also having them follow players.

That might sound a bit scary, but there are a bunch of ways to counter them! The obvious one – just move. But besides that, you can also shoot or deflect these with your particle blade.

To make it even more interesting in terms of deflection, once you hit these spheres with a particle blade they will actually stop following you and start homing in on the enemies, giving you this little new ally.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9fetzpG.gif[/img]

My intention with this enemy was to make it more like a pest that isn’t quite dangerous up front BUT needs to be dealt with fast, otherwise it's going to spawn too many of these energy spheres until you get overwhelmed.

And just to prevent you from simply shooting it down, the only way to destroy it is by hitting the glowing part on it’s back. You will need to hit its head first to make it spin around, so it can get a little tricky. Or just use explosives. They work fine here.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HQUCdlp.png[/img]

Second enemy I have made is a bit more straightforward. I am currently calling it a Whisp but it might need to be renamed as I don’t think the name is a perfect match with what this turned out to be.

The goal with this enemy was to make something that is opposite of Khepri as in – something that is fast and hard to hit.

The way it behaves is – it zips around in an unpredictable way until it decides to focus on you and blast you with its weapon. From tests so far, it can get pretty stressful when you are facing other enemies, and all of a sudden you see a Whisp start charging its cannon aimed at you. It is also surrounded by spinning blades, so you probably shouldn’t touch it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ppIPBY1.gif[/img]

As for counterplay – the basic version of it is very fragile, requiring you to only hit it once to destroy it. You can deflect its shots with the particle blade. You may even want to completely avoid destroying it since dodging the projectiles can make it kill other enemies for you. Handy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3r5nOy4.png[/img]

An explosive roller! This is just that.

Originally it was intended as a joke, but then I took myself seriously and actually made it. This is dedicated to anyone who played the demo and spawn killed the enemies by putting their blade into a spawn zone.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zhn9yvS.gif[/img] 

It resembles the existing roller enemy but this one has a mine inside it. I know, amazing design. This enemy will troll the spawn killers and will also make you move around even more since, you know, avoiding explosions is generally a good idea.

And while it can be extremely deadly to you, it is also deadly to other enemies if you time it right.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r5KMhEt.gif[/img]

And that should do it for today’s devlog! There are certainly more enemies coming to [b]SpiderHeck[/b] in the future, these are just the ones I am ready to talk about. Let me know what you think of these and don’t forget to wishlist the game! 

Thank you,
[i]Neverjam[/i]

tags.balance_change: So instead I slowed the projectiles down quite a bit, and to still keep them a threat, made the spheres bigger while also having them follow players.

An explosive roller! This is just that.

notes.title: SpiderHeck demo patch 0.71 is live
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone,

I’ve just rolled out an update for the SpiderHeck demo to address a few quality of life changes, improve balancing and add localization.

Thank you to everyone who provided feedback![/h3]

[list]
[*] The demo has been localized into 10 more languages (French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Changed colors of certain effects to help visibility.
[*] Rebalanced weapon variety in both Survival and Waves.
[*] Empty weapons now disintegrate instantly.
[*] First map in Versus and Survival is now randomized from a preset selection of "easier" maps.
[*] Mines now better show if they are armed or activated.
[*] Improvements to Roller enemy collisions... hopefully they will get stuck less? Maybe? Finally?
[*] Reduced cooldown for both jumping and using the web.
[*] Reduced effects of "Power Web" and "Strong Legs" modifiers to make them easier to control.
[*] Overall reduced camera shake by about 20%.
[*] Remote Play Together easier to access through the pause menu in the lobby.
[*] Controllers can now use dpad for movement.
[*] Railvolvers are no longer cool thus they don't get affected by "Cool Explosions" modifier.
[*] Basic particle blade made slightly longer.
[*] Purple Rollers now show if their "legs" have been damaged.
[*] Explosion effects last 25% shorter amount of time.
[/list]


[h3]Once again thank you to everyone who got in touch.

-Neverjam[/h3]
